boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Pepperdine traditions spanning service, welcome, performance, remembrance, and campus celebration.

cards.title: Waves of Flags
cards.subtitle: September remembrance in Alumni Park
cards.notes: Walk the Alumni Park installation respectfully and read the messages of remembrance attached to the flagpoles during the annual observance.
cards.short_summary: A student-started 9/11 memorial display that has become a Pepperdine tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine says students started Waves of Flags in 2008 and that it became a campus tradition commemorating lives lost on September 11, 2001.
cards.access_notes: The official page describes an annual September display in Alumni Park; consult the current event page before visiting.

cards.title: Step Forward Day
cards.subtitle: Annual community-service day
cards.notes: Register through Community Engagement and Service when projects are announced, then join a designated service activity with the Pepperdine community.
cards.short_summary: A service tradition begun by Seaver students in 1988.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine identifies Step Forward Day as a tradition dating to 1988, when two Seaver students organized an annual day of service.
cards.source_title: Step Forward Day Inspires Generations of Waves to Serve Their Local Community and Impact the World Around Them
cards.access_notes: Held annually in September; project locations and participation details vary by year.

cards.title: Founder's Day
cards.subtitle: Opening-of-year commemoration
cards.notes: Follow the current program for the annual ceremony, which marks the academic year and recognizes George Pepperdine’s founding vision.
cards.short_summary: A university ceremony that formally opens the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine describes Founder's Day as an annual university tradition that declares the beginning of the academic year and commemorates its founder.
cards.access_notes: The cited ceremony took place in Alumni Park; confirm the current year’s location and attendance details.

cards.title: Christmas Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: December gathering at Joslyn Plaza
cards.notes: Attend the December program in Joslyn Plaza for worship and the culminating lighting of Pepperdine’s Christmas tree.
cards.short_summary: An annual faith-centered tree-lighting ceremony in Joslyn Plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Activities calls the Christmas Tree Lighting an annual tradition in Joslyn Plaza that culminates in lighting the tree each December.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled annually in December; verify the current program and any attendance guidance.

cards.title: Dance in Flight
cards.subtitle: Student dance-company showcase
cards.notes: Watch for the March showcase, or follow the company’s current announcements if you want to see student choreography and performance.
cards.short_summary: A long-running student dance company and annual March showcase.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine says Dance in Flight has provided a student dance and choreography environment for more than 30 years and presents an annual March showcase.
cards.access_notes: The official page identifies March as the showcase period; check the current production’s ticket and access information.

cards.title: The Pepp Gala
cards.subtitle: April semester-closing formal
cards.notes: Check Student Activities announcements for the year’s theme and color palette before attending this end-of-semester campus formal.
cards.short_summary: A themed April formal used to conclude the semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine states that Student Activities hosts The Pepp Gala in April as a formal way to conclude the semester, with an annual theme and color palette.
cards.access_notes: Held in April; the official page does not publish recurring admission or participation requirements.

cards.title: Late Night Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Pre-finals meal with faculty and staff
cards.notes: Look for the end-of-semester announcement and join faculty and staff for breakfast favorites, karaoke, and a break before finals.
cards.short_summary: Faculty and staff serve students a pre-finals breakfast at each semester’s end.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine says Late Night Breakfast occurs at the end of both fall and spring semesters, when faculty and staff serve students before finals.
cards.access_notes: The official page gives no recurring start or end time; consult the current Student Activities event listing.

cards.title: Waves Weekend
cards.subtitle: October community weekend
cards.notes: Use the year’s Waves Weekend schedule to choose an activity with students, families, alumni, faculty, staff, and friends of the university.
cards.short_summary: An October weekend that brings Pepperdine’s wider community together.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Student Activities says Waves Weekend occurs every October and celebrates students, families, alumni, faculty, staff, and friends across its schools and colleges.
cards.access_notes: Annual October programming varies; consult the current event schedule for individual activity access.

cards.title: Frosh Follies
cards.subtitle: First-year house skits during orientation
cards.notes: If you are a new student, ask your orientation or residence-life leader how your first-year house participates in the current program.
cards.short_summary: A decades-old orientation skit tradition built around Pepperdine stories.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Graphic reports that first-year houses perform Frosh Follies skits about aspects of Pepperdine and that it has been part of New Student Orientation for decades.
cards.source_title: “Moments in Time”: A History of Pepperdine Traditions
cards.access_notes: Participation is associated with New Student Orientation; current format and eligibility may change.

cards.title: Songfest
cards.subtitle: Discontinued student mini-musical competition
cards.notes: Explore archival photos and accounts of this former tradition rather than planning to participate; current students no longer hold the event.
cards.short_summary: A former spring mini-musical competition that evolved from Spring Sing.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Graphic reports that Songfest was a spring student mini-musical competition, evolved from Spring Sing after the move to Malibu, and is no longer an event for current students.
cards.source_title: “Moments in Time”: A History of Pepperdine Traditions
cards.access_notes: Discontinued for current students, according to the cited 2025 student-media history.
